objective: Bounded, source-decodable test of whether a publicly plausible Qwen3 initializer stream predicts enough final expert-weight energy to close the charged F gap without increasing expert reads above 2x.

claim_boundary.public_lineage_status: initializer family and scale are public; production seed, RNG implementation, framework, construction order, offsets, and parallel layout are not public
claim_boundary.positive_result: auxiliary survivor only; requires a separately frozen gate-role protocol and full physical codec replay
claim_boundary.negative_result: rejects only this finite candidate lock, not every possible initializer lineage or procedural predictor
claim_boundary.forbidden_claim: No candidate is described as the actual Qwen production initializer unless independently documented. Safetensors serialization order is never treated as initialization order.

exclusion_manifest.runtime_rule: revalidate the full manifest when present; otherwise use only the separately sealed exact tensor-identity intersection

data_firewall.down_canonicalization: transpose native [2048,768] to [768,2048] only after sparse coordinate reads
data_firewall.required_directory_rule: exactly 32 regular non-symlink files l15e{expert}_{up|down}.bf16.bin and no other *.bf16.bin

sampler.allocation: independent quotient-remainder allocation over the 31 eligible tensors in frozen source-manifest order
sampler.algorithm: SHA256 rejection sampling of u64 lanes, domain-separated by revision, tensor identity, and split; reject modulo tail and duplicates

regression.fit_rule: independent float64 ordinary least squares with intercept per matrix on fit coordinates only
regression.score_rule: score coordinates only; denominator is squared error of the serialized fit-only mean predictor
regression.reported_correlation: score-only centered Pearson correlation; descriptive and never used to refit mu or alpha
regression.winner_rule: minimum pooled candidate-selection score q, then frozen candidate ordinal
regression.fold_unit: whole untouched validation expert pooled over up and down

families_in_order.stream_scope: reset the same seed at every tensor
reset at the beginning of each decoder layer
one model-body stream beginning at embedding post_init

families_in_order.framework_hypothesis: direct Transformers v4.51.0 construction followed by post_init
families_in_order.stream_scope: one stream including reachable and overwritten torch module constructor draws before post_init

cuda_parity.authoritative_generator: torch.Generator(device='cuda') normal_ with explicit Philox offset
cuda_parity.cupy_role: batched float64 sufficient-statistic evaluation and deterministic device-side staging via DLPack
cuda_parity.offset_formula: PyTorch DistributionTemplates calc_execution_policy for contiguous normal float4, checked against Generator.get_offset
requirements: CuPy CUDA available on the same device
calculated offset increments exactly match observed increments for both locked dtype paths
sequential-stream target equals offset-jump target bitwise
DLPack CuPy view equals the PyTorch tensor bitwise
cuda_parity.failure: abort before source payload access; never skip a locked Tier-A candidate family or substitute another RNG

matched_gaussian.generation: stateless SHA256 Box-Muller, domain separated by tensor and split
matched_gaussian.moments: per-matrix fit-only Qwen mean and centered RMS

permuted_anchor.generation: fixed SHA256 ordering permutation independently within each matrix and split

controls.bias_correction: validation source capture minus max(0, matched-Gaussian validation capture, permuted-anchor validation capture)

target_math.metadata_adjustment: recomputed from physical_ledger at runtime and independently by verifier
target_math.hard_kill: bias-corrected validation capture + 2 whole-expert SE is below metadata-adjusted composite requirement
target_math.composite_only: not hard-killed but standalone promotion does not pass
target_math.standalone_promotion: bias-corrected validation capture - 2 whole-expert SE reaches metadata-adjusted current requirement and every whole-expert fold has positive raw capture

physical_ledger.decoder_executable_accounting: No model-specific generator table exists. Executable code is treated identically to the baseline codec implementation; a separate self-contained 4096-byte descriptor sensitivity is also reported.

execution.cpu_backend: unit-test/preflight only and categorically rejected by production verifier
